headline: Call of Duty 4 - Modern Warfare
title: Call of Duty 4 Modern Warfare 2007 | Series Turning Point | Classic Games
video_script: Call of Duty four changed the series. Modern Warfare was developed by Infinity Ward and published by Activision, and it launched in North America on November fifth, two thousand seven. It broke away from World War Two and moved the series into a modern setting, starting the Modern Warfare line. Which mission still stays with you? Comment below!
description: Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare was released in North America on November 5, 2007, developed by Infinity Ward and published by Activision, moving the series to a modern setting.
